stem:
The diagram shows Kiara holding an opaque comb between a lamp and a white screen. Light from the lamp is blocked by the comb before it reaches the screen.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Moving the comb closer to the screen makes the shadow on the screen smaller.
Moving the comb closer to the lamp makes the shadow on the screen larger.
The same shadow remains visible on the screen after the lamp is switched off.
Moving the comb closer to the lamp makes the shadow on the screen smaller.

teacher.key_rationale: Shadow size depends on object position: closer to the screen shrinks the shadow; closer to the lamp enlarges it. With the lamp off there is no shadow, and the reverse size claim is wrong.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote lens-ray figure into lamp, opaque comb, and shadow on a screen.
